integrity: The fresh primary full text was inspected at the regular-Coulomb differential equation, Riccati functional, Theorem 4.3, and its critical-point proof. The local rate was reconstructed from the exact algebraic critical-point equation by an implicit-function expansion. The index conversion was checked against the full 2024 McMahon-type zero-asymptotic article, and the earlier 2015 Coulomb Turán paper was inspected for broader coverage. Numerical calculations are not used to prove the asymptotic statements.
scientific_limitations: The result is a fixed-parameter asymptotic for the Riccati-normalized regular-Coulomb Turán minima introduced in the cited 2026 paper. It is not uniform as the Coulomb parameter tends to zero with the nodal index, and it does not address order-monotonicity in L. The bounded phase in the Coulomb zero asymptotic is absorbed into the order n^{-2} remainder.
title: Inverse-linear Coulomb law for sharp Turán minima
